verses.en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.pt: Disse eu: Guardarei os meus caminhos para não pecar com a minha língua; guardarei a minha boca com uma mordaça, enquanto o ímpio estiver diante de mim.
verses.en_web: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David.> I said, I will give attention to my ways, so that my tongue may do no wrong; I will keep my mouth under control, while the sinner is before me.

verses.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.pt: Com silêncio fiquei qual um mundo; calava-me mesmo acerca do bem; mas a minha dor se agravou.
verses.en_web: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
verses.en_bbe: I made no sound, I said no word, even of good; and I was moved with sorrow.

verses.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.pt: Escandesceu-se dentro de mim o meu coração; enquanto eu meditava acendeu-se o fogo; então com a minha língua, dizendo;
verses.en_web: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
verses.en_bbe: My heart was burning in my breast; while I was deep in thought the fire was lighted; then I said with my tongue,

verses.en: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
verses.pt: Faze-me conhecer, ó Senhor, o meu fim, e qual a medida dos meus dias, para que eu saiba quão frágil sou.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, give me knowledge of my end, and of the measure of my days, so that I may see how feeble I am.

verses.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.pt: Eis que mediste os meus dias a palmos; o tempo da minha vida é como que nada diante de ti. Na verdade, todo homem, por mais firme que esteja, é totalmente vaidade.
verses.en_web: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You have made my days no longer than a hand's measure; and my years are nothing in your eyes; truly, every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

verses.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.pt: Na verdade, todo homem anda qual uma sombra; na verdade, em vão se inquieta, amontoa riquezas, e não sabe quem as levará.
verses.en_web: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, every man goes on his way like an image; he is troubled for no purpose: he makes a great store of wealth, and has no knowledge of who will get it.

verses.en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, Senhor, que espero eu? a minha esperança está em ti.
verses.en_web: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
verses.en_bbe: And now, Lord, what am I waiting for? my hope is in you.

verses.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.pt: Livra-me de todas as minhas transgressões; não me faças o opróbrio do insensato.
verses.en_web: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
verses.en_bbe: Make me free from all my sins; do not let me be shamed by the man of evil behaviour.

verses.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.pt: Emudecido estou, não abro a minha boca; pois tu és que agiste,
verses.en_web: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
verses.en_bbe: I was quiet, and kept my mouth shut; because you had done it.

verses.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.pt: Tira de sobre mim o teu flagelo; estou desfalecido pelo golpe da tua mão.
verses.en_web: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
verses.en_bbe: No longer let your hand be hard on me; I am wasted by the blows of your hand.

verses.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.pt: Quando com repreensões castigas o homem por causa da iniquidade, destróis, como traça, o que ele tem de precioso; na verdade todo homem é vaidade.
verses.en_web: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, You consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: By the weight of your wrath against man's sin, the glory of his form is wasted away; truly every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.pt: Ouve, Senhor, a minha oração, e inclina os teus ouvidos ao meu clamor; não te cales perante as minhas lágrimas, porque sou para contigo como um estranho, um peregrino como todos os meus pais.
verses.en_web: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
verses.en_bbe: Let my prayer come to your ears, O Lord, and give attention to my cry, make an answer to my weeping: for my time here is short before you, and in a little time I will be gone, like all my fathers.

verses.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.pt: Desvia de mim o teu olhar, para que eu tome alento, antes que me vá e não exista mais.
verses.en_web: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more.”
verses.en_bbe: Let your wrath be turned away from me, so that I may be comforted, before I go away from here, and become nothing.
